title: I burned down one of the malls.
content: And it started time-traveling after that. But this was the very end of the dream. I went into a gigantic tower mall. At the bottom floor there was a grocery store, stocked with all kinds of fresh food for ludicrously cheap prices. For example, an entire turkey-sized chicken was $3.30, not per-pound, no it was the whole thing for that price. I didn't buy anything though. I went to the next floor, and it was a lobby like in a fancy hotel. There was an elevator in the center of the room with two doors for some reason. I went in and it immediately tried to take me to one of the top floors, 80-something. I left the elevator when it got there, and entered another large space. This time it seemed to be a common area or directory of some kind, with multiple crossing paths. Everything was shiny and clean. The signs were in some script I didn't recognize. I turned around and now, next to the elevator, there is a staircase with red rails, very wide, marked with a drawing of a flame. Fire exit, I guess. I decided to take the stairs down just to see where they went, and suddenly my cat is with me. The stairs don't go anywhere special, so I pick up my cat and take the elevator. Suddenly the elevator started going up to the 110th floor, or so it said, I thought there weren't any more floors? The interior door didn't close all the way, and I'm holding my cat tightly. I fell over due to the speed of the elevator. Then it slowed down, dinged "110", but the exterior door didn't open. The elevator then slowly descended back to a different 80-something floor. This time there's a series of offices, for a bank. I learn that the entire building is owned by a bank. This is not interesting, so I get back in the elevator. The elevator began rapidly dropping back down to the first floor. I got to the first floor safely and my cat calmly hops out of my arms and trots out the front door. Somehow I trusted him to go back home, and that was that. I walked outside too, and there's a group of people just lighting random things on fire. Mostly trash. I talk to them, and they tell me the bank that owns the building is corrupt and needs to be taken down. I ask them why, but they don't explain and just continue playing with fire. One of them goes inside and pulls all the fire alarms, causing a mass evacuation. Then I asked, hey, did everyone get out? And it's confirmed to me multiple times that it's all clear. That's when I get my idea. I go "hey, check this out" and light something on fire, then throw it inside the first floor lobby. Somehow, and I have no idea how because this should not have been possible, the ENTIRE BUILDING CATCHES FIRE. Yes, from one little ball of burning paper. Anyway, it somehow made sense in the dream, and the whole crowd starts cheering. The building burns until it is a burned out shell of its former self. The dream flashed to a scene a bit after the fire, the crowd has left and fire investigators are on the scene. They're talking to me, and I casually mention I set the fire. But this isn't a problem for some reason. They're just like, "okay cool" and start to leave. But then I start walking back in the building, and they're like "no! don't go in there! it's unstable!" Too late, I'm inside...and the building is now a completely different one, unburned of course, and I can see a calendar says it's 2007. I didn't like that year, so I set this building on fire too, in the same unbelievable way, and it shifts yet again to a completely different building and this time it's 2010. 2010 also sucked. Fire time. Now I'm back to the present day, but the building is in its original unburned state like at the start of the dream. This annoys me. I set it on fire in the exact same way as before...then I woke up.
